prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical Instagram cover image, 4:5
Primary request: A photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing scene on a coastal course beneath a large dramatic stormy sky, with strong wind and choppy water. Two or three boats travel in a close pack while exiting a turn.
Subject: Every boat is a true Japanese kyotei racing boat: a single-seat craft about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a light white or pale-grey hull. Each has an OPEN cockpit with no canopy, no roof, and no windshield bubble. Each racer crouches or kneels very low inside, leans forward, and holds a small steering wheel with both hands. Racers wear plain full-face helmets and plain racing suits; faces are completely hidden. Each boat has exactly one outboard motor at the stern and a large white spray plume behind it.
Composition/framing: vertical 4:5. Keep the racing boats in the lower half. Reserve the top 45% as dark, uncluttered dramatic sky suitable for later title overlay, but do not add any title. Dynamic sports-photography perspective.
Lighting/mood: windswept, intense, cinematic natural light, realistic spray and waves.
Text: none.
Constraints: no recognizable real person; no canopy, roof, windshield bubble, offshore powerboat, or F1 tunnel boat.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, emblems, sponsor marks, or readable markings anywhere, including on boats, helmets, suits, shoreline, or sky.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows three low, long, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boats in a close pack exiting a turn on choppy coastal water beneath a large dark stormy sky. Each racer is crouched low with a plain full-face helmet and hidden face, and each boat has one stern outboard motor with white spray. The upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
